block.ribbits.brown_toadstool.descriptio: A solid fungal building block. Large swamp Toadstools are built from these and Toadstool Stems.
block.ribbits.red_toadstool.description: A solid fungal building block. Large swamp Toadstools are built from these and Toadstool Stems.
block.ribbits.toadstool_stem.description: The stem of a large Toadstool.
block.ribbits.toadstool.description: A swamp plant that can be spread into a patch with Bone Meal.
block.ribbits.swamp_lantern.description: A waterloggable light source that can be hung from the ceiling or placed on the ground.
block.ribbits.giant_lilypad.description: A wide lily pad that floats on water and is sturdy enough to walk on. Bone Meal grows a larger patch.
block.ribbits.swamp_daisy.description: A swamp flower that can be spread into a patch with Bone Meal.
block.ribbits.umbrella_leaf.description: A broad-leaved swamp plant that can be spread into a patch with Bone Meal.
block.ribbits.mossy_oak_planks.descripti: A mossy variant of Oak Planks, crafted from Oak Planks and Moss Block or Vines.
block.ribbits.mossy_oak_planks_stairs.de: Mossy Oak Stairs, crafted from Mossy Oak Planks.
block.ribbits.mossy_oak_planks_slab.desc: Mossy Oak Slab, crafted from Mossy Oak Planks.
block.ribbits.mossy_oak_planks_fence.des: Mossy Oak Fence, crafted from Mossy Oak Planks.
block.ribbits.mossy_oak_planks_fence_gat: A Mossy Oak gate that connects to fences, but can be opened like a door.
block.ribbits.mossy_oak_door.description: A Mossy Oak door that can be opened and closed, by hand or with Redstone Power.
item.ribbits.maraca.description: A percussion instrument. Hold it to shake it, and join in when Ribbits play music.
item.ribbits.ribbit_nitwit_spawn_egg.des: A Ribbit with no trade and no job. It still joins in when the band plays.
A Ribbit that fishes in the swamp and trades in swamp plants and Maracas.
item.ribbits.ribbit_gardener_spawn_egg.d: A Ribbit that waters nearby crops.
item.ribbits.ribbit_merchant_spawn_egg.d: A Ribbit that trades in swamp plants and Maracas.
item.ribbits.ribbit_sorcerer_spawn_egg.d: A Ribbit that occasionally casts a spell to buff nearby players.
entity.ribbits.ribbit.description: A passive mob found in swamp villages that plays music in groups and trades in Amethyst. Right-click with Amethyst to set its new home.
